digest.component_or_area: store sync and push union guards
propositions: A stale clone with mismatched epoch must refuse to union at sync._union_merge by returning without merging, preserving both local and remote refs exactly.

A stale clone reaching push_tickets_branch non-fast-forward retry must abort the retry loop immediately via return (not break) when epoch mismatch is detected, with zero merge invocations and zero further push attempts.

The epoch field in .store-compat.json must be a JSON string (opaque, byte-equality comparison only), with corrupt or non-string values treated as abort conditions matching format_version type strictness.

The state-matrix must distinguish all nine combinations: both records absent, record absent vs present epoch-absent, both epoch-absent, equal epochs, mismatched epochs, and the two asymmetric cases (absent vs present), plus corrupt/unparseable records and unreadable remote refs.
Remote epoch checking must read via git show <remote_ref>:.store-compat.json and distinguish file-absent from ref-unreadable in log messages, since remedies differ (re-clone vs fix remote).

After guard-aborted non-fast-forward push, fsck must report DIVERGED (not PUSH_PENDING), and a matching-epoch behind clone must still converge via fast-forward adoption while ahead clones return early.
